name: Autobiographical memory questionnaire (MAQ-10): online survey data
description: Responses of 60 adults to the MAQ-10, a 10-item questionnaire on autobiographical memory, collected online with Qualtrics in April 2025. One row per respondent. Identifying columns (IP address, location, e-mail) were removed before deposit.
measurementTechnique: Online questionnaire (Qualtrics), MAQ-10, 10 items on a 1-5 scale
author: TODO

variableMeasured.name: StartDate
variableMeasured.description: Date and time the questionnaire was started.

variableMeasured.name: duration_s
variableMeasured.description: Time taken to complete the questionnaire.

variableMeasured.name: Genere
variableMeasured.description: Gender. Coding: Donna = woman; Uomo = man; Non binario = non-binary.

variableMeasured.name: attention_check
variableMeasured.description: Instructed-response item (respondents were asked to select 3). Coding: 3 = correct response; any other value = failed.

variableMeasured.name: Q1
variableMeasured.description: MAQ-10 item 1. Coding: 1 = not at all (per nulla); 5 = very much (moltissimo).
